What to find: Known technical limitations, risks and failure modes.

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: The card notes a Transformers config error that caused long-context performance degradation (fixed in a later commit); GGUFs generated from the earlier config are also affected, and frameworks relying on the config must be updated or performance will be subpar, especially in long-context sessions. It also says local serving may be subpar, in which case the Mistral AI API is recommended.
quotes: The Transformers config originally had an incorrect entry that caused long-context performance degradation.
GGUFs generated using the Transformers config prior to this commit are also affected.
Otherwise, you will experience subpar performance, especially in long-context sessions.
For optimal performance, we recommend using the Mistral AI API if local serving is subpar.
